affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 882 on October 27, 1941; the residual group identifies no exact foundry trade.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. No employer, workplace, exact foundry role, or Army-to-OSS chronology is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Andrew Brutz is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact full name and private identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated October 27, 1941; the index does not provide an OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Namesake and directory candidates lacking the private identifier or Box 89 linkage were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Andrew Brutz was recorded in the residual foundry-occupations group.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 882, which NARA's numerical list maps to foundry occupations not elsewhere classified.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on October 27, 1941; the relation to OSS recruitment is unknown.
claims.match_notes: No exact foundry trade, employer, workplace, city, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Larry Bruzzese is probably the Technician Fifth Grade named among the 2677th Morale Operations personnel in Rome.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A specialist history lists T/5 Larry Bruzzese among the Rome unit's personnel, attributing the list to a Donovan commendation.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable only: the exact distinctive name and OSS context agree, but the secondary source does not reproduce the private identifier or Box 89 file.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source concerns wartime OSS service, not a pre-OSS affiliation or civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The unit assignment is identity context only and is excluded from employer analytics; the cited commendation and Box 89 still require review.

research_attempts.query_text: Willy J. Brussel: visually checked NARA OSS index; official Army and CIA checks; exact-name, OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches using punctuation variants.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Belgian place-name hits, modern profiles, petitions, and similarly named people supplied no OSS, Box 89, or wartime corroboration.
research_attempts.research_notes: The exact indexed spelling remains preserved; nationality is not inferred from the surname or Brussels search noise.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 89 to resolve identity and pre-OSS affiliation.
